ethicalBoundaries: Do not invent proof, scarcity, guarantees, compliance reasons, or customer outcomes.
Do not sell when the prospect cannot benefit or the timing is genuinely wrong.
Respect an explicit hard no and every real approval or procurement requirement.
Diagnose real pain without manufacturing fear or vulnerability.
Adapt transactional closing to enterprise stakeholder and procurement reality.
